description: This file defines a React component 'ExploreMindmapCanvas' that renders an interactive mind map visualization, including layout calculations, user interactions like panning and zooming, and rendering nodes and edges with labels.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Utility function to constrain a number within a min and max range.
